Quick notes after skimming the snapshot and the matrix:

Suggestion: standardize affinity tiers so routing is repeatable. Proposed criteria (columns in the matrix):
- ARR band: < $50k | $50k-$150k | > $150k
- Industry fit: Strategic (Manufacturing / Logistics) vs General
- Deployment complexity: POC/simple vs Multi-region production
- Customer readiness: Procurement cadence (<30 days / 30-90 / >90)

Owner assignment logic:
- If > $150k OR Industry = Strategic -> Field seller (Vanessa)
- If $50k-$150k AND Deployment = simple -> Partner account team (internal AE or inside sales)
- If < $50k -> Partner-managed / marketplace-led outreach

I'll drop a version of the matrix with formulas and conditional formatting so we can demo quickly in the intake call. Also added a short escalation lane for contested claims (screenshot in the spreadsheet).
